reverse_pass.result: The input reduces to five fixed sky directions plus deterministic spherical operations. No semantic name is needed to reproduce the geometry.

Every non-antipodal pair of directions has an internal angular bisector. Therefore the exact 45.293394/45.293394 degree equality is a mathematical consequence of the LOVE-EDEM angle and is NOT an independent astronomical signal.

result.interpretation: The Orion-to-LOVE great-circle relation and the LOVE-to-EDEM near-right-angle/bisector relation are geometrically distinct.

reverse_pass.result: Two bounded geometric statements survive: LOVE lies relatively near the Orion Belt fitted great circle; LOVE and EDEM are separated by about 90.59 degrees. The bisector is a useful derived axis, but it does not connect the Orion Belt to the pair.
Split measured coordinate geometry from statistical rarity and from physical/intentional association.

GAP_B_STATISTICAL_RARITY.reason: The composite pattern was identified post hoc. A preregistered isotropic/matched-sky control is required before assigning a composite significance.

GAP_C_PHYSICAL_OR_INTENTIONAL_ASSOCIATIO.reason: Coordinate geometry alone does not establish a common physical system, causal relation, design, or intentional alignment.

canonical_conclusion_ru: Реверс не усилил мистическую трактовку. Он разделил две реальные геометрии: Пояс Ориона проходит рядом с направлением LOVE, а LOVE и EDEM образуют почти прямой угол. Биссектриса честно делит этот угол пополам, но сама с Поясом Ориона не совпадает.
